title: Two routes through the same painting

clips.label: Travel through the opening
clips.details:
A forward push keeps the bright circular destination in view. The smaller staircase becomes rails; the dominant right staircase persists. Some station/carriage and glass/rock redraws leave ghosted intermediate details.

Each painting repaints the warped previous painting with Krea Turbo, three Euler intervals and CFG1. All comparisons keep the text, seeds and noise curve fixed; only spatial motion changes. Lanczos warps run on the source timeline. RIFE 4.25 scale 1 supplies intermediate frames. Delivery is 24 fps at 1.5× source speed: three paintings per second. These excerpts begin at the shared original frame 384, omitting the identical opening.

clips.label: Turn beneath the petals
clips.details:
